integrity: All mathematical formulas and hypotheses are documented in RESULT.md. The standalone exact-rational checker tests eleven examples but does not replace the proof for every real parameter. Public bibliographic dates are sourced from initial arXiv preprint submissions.
scientific_limitations: The construction settles the generalized Hata–Yano half of the cited existence problem for all 0<δ≤1/6, but not the arbitrary Gharaei–Homburg half. It proves existence, not uniqueness; the number of atoms is parameter-dependent. The arcsine consequence invokes the existing source theorem for finite-support initial points; independent audit and exhaustive publication-priority verification have not occurred.
title: Finite core witnesses throughout the generalized Hata–Yano parameter interval
